Hi — I'm Sarah from the legal coordination team at TaskFlow (we're a B2B project management SaaS). We need a proper Cookie Policy page document for our website. Our users are mostly EU-based.

I have some rough internal notes at `compliance/cookie_policy_raw_notes.txt` that list the cookies we actually use, but they're a mess and definitely not ready for publication.

Can you produce a structured, publication-ready Cookie Policy document and save it as `cookie_policy.md`? It should cover everything we need for the page to go live — the right sections, whether Google should index it or not, where it should be linked from on the site, and any important caveats we should know about. We haven't had a lawyer look at this yet.
